entities.summary: Colbert was an anti-air cruiser, later transformed into a missile cruiser, of the French Navy. She was the sixth ship of the French Navy to be named after Jean-Baptiste Colbert. She served in the Navy from 1956 to 1991, before being converted into a museum ship at Bordeaux from 1993. Colbert was scrapped in 2016.
